variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
